name: Divine Ornament "Amlethal"
location: Rotating Event - Ravage of the Azure Swordsman (Gaia)

skillset.skill: 40s CT - Reduces all Allies' Fire Elemental DMG Taken by 15% for 10s. Heals all Allies' HP by 20/s for 10s. If User is Water Elemental then Healing x 1.5.

passive.ability1: Increases DEF by 10% when unit is negating DMG.
